name: Cartas al pie — direct manipulation of the existing /planes page

axes.concept: Direct manipulation on an informational page: the only things a visitor operates are the existing controls (Idioma select, back link, account menu, sign-in Planes link), and the Idioma select edits the page in place — names, tool lists and COP⇄USD prices roll and settle without navigation. Cards are articles, never controls.
axes.layout: Published ComparadorPlanes shell (masthead, H1 + back link, administrator line, footer) with the comparison tabs and «Ir a un plan» rail removed; four separate peer cards in catalogue order at natural height (align-items:start), identity blocks of equal height so every price sits on one shared line; 4 columns ≥1100px, 2×2 at 640–1099px, one column below 640px.
axes.navigation: No in-page navigation at all: no tabs, side index, anchors or selection summary. Plain vertical scroll; back link (sign-in for signed-out, previous page for signed-in), Idioma select, and the unchanged cuentas-admin@v2 account menu whose Planes entry carries aria-current on /planes.
axes.typography: Product Geist scale: H1 24/600, plan name 18/600, price 30/600 tabular figures with 13px «COP / mes» unit (26px on phones), 12px «Herramientas incluidas» label, 14px tool rows, 12px «aún no disponible» marker.
axes.density: Comfortable: 24px card padding (20px phone), 16px gap between cards (12px phone), 6px tool row rhythm, 96px identity block; full cumulative lists always expanded.
axes.components: Existing vocabulary only: native select (Idioma), back link, ruled card with Check-icon tool list, shadcn Skeleton for loading, shadcn Button for the error retry, cuentas-admin@v2 MenuCuenta popup and LoginForm Planes link unchanged.
axes.colour: Pictures globals.css tokens, both themes: superficie cards on fondo, borde-suave rules, acento only on available-tool checks and focus ring, aviso on unavailable checks/markers, error/error-suave for the catalogue error; no card is tinted, highlighted or badged.
axes.motion: Tactile press/settle grammar shared with cuentas-admin@v2 dir C: cards drop and settle (translateY 18px, scale .97 → rest, cubic-bezier(.34,1.42,.64,1), 460ms, 70ms stagger in catalogue order), tool rows follow at 35ms; changing Idioma presses the select (scale .92 → 1.04 → 1) and rolls each price vertically (old out up, new in from below on the profile spring) while lists re-settle with no delay; back link compresses to .96 and its chevron nudges −3px; reduced motion/Quieto swaps instantly.
